content.short: aeoniumsky is a visionary NFT creator from the future, renowned for their surreal and dreamlike animated artworks.
content.description: Aeoniumsky is an art based NFT project only on Cardano. The core project follows Series 01 of the BLOCKS an interconnecting animated illustration made up of 24 BLOCKS(3x8 BLOCKS). Each BLOCK captures moments in time in the NFT space and aeonsphere to form a never ending digital tapestry. Blending the boundaries between reality and imagination, their creations are a feast for the senses, inviting viewers on a journey through a fantastical alternate universes. Welcome to aeoniumsky. aeoniumsky is derived from the greek word aeonium meaning ’ageless or limitless’’, paired with sky to mean an infinite or never-ending sky. ay-oh-nee-uhm sky (as in sky).
